# Invisit

> > Delhi-based travel agency specializing in Himalayan destinations including Leh Ladakh, Kashmir, Manali, Spiti Valley, and pilgrimage tours to Kedarnath.

Invisit offers curated tour packages across India with a strong focus on North India mountain destinations, adventure travel, and spiritual journeys. The agency provides both customized private tours and weekend group departures for destinations like Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Ladakh, and pilgrimage circuits.

## Key Topics

- Leh Ladakh tours
- Kashmir tour packages
- Manali holiday trips
- Spiti Valley expeditions
- Kedarnath pilgrimage
- Nubra Valley
- Weekend group tours
- Honeymoon packages
- Adventure travel
- Mountain passes (Khardung La, Rohtang Pass)
- Mughal Gardens
- Monastery tours
- North India tourism
- Himalayan destinations
- Road trips
